issues.legal_issue: A mortgage by deposit of title deeds is created when there is a debt, a deposit of title deeds, and an intention that the deeds secure the debt.
A memorandum that merely records a completed mortgage by deposit of title deeds, without creating or extinguishing rights or liabilities, does not require registration.
The agreement and surrounding evidence established a mortgage by deposit of title deeds securing the debt.
A party who admits signing an agreement but alleges coercion or threat bears the burden of proving that allegation.
An appeal may proceed to final hearing in a party’s absence when that party does not appear, but the decision must be assessed on the evidence and applicable law.
The order dismissing the request to reopen the appeal became ineffective once the order allowing the appeal was set aside, even though the dismissal order was otherwise legally sound.
The contractual interest rate of 36% per annum was excessive, and simple interest should be reduced to 12% per annum from the date of the agreement until realization.
Delay in filing an appeal may be condoned when a liberal approach serves the interests of justice, subject to appropriate costs.
